title: Delegation Asymmetry in Agentic Recommender Systems: Measuring Two-Sided Receptivity in Online Dating
summary: Delegation Asymmetry in Agentic Recommender Systems: Measuring Two-Sided Receptivity in Online Dating｜Autonomous LLM agents that converse on a user's behalf are an emerging design

extra.description: Autonomous LLM agents that converse on a user's behalf are an emerging design pattern in matching platforms, yet their viability depends on a condition rarely examined: users must accept not only delegating conversation to an agent, but also receiving agent-mediated communication from others.
